correctness.rationale: With local quadratic step eta=1/a, the first local update reaches b_i and all later local gradients vanish. Hence FedNova normalized gradient d_i=a(x-b_i)/tau_i. Its prescribed tau_eff=(tau_1+tau_2)/2 for equal clients gives x^+=x-(tau_1+tau_2)/4[(x-b_1)/tau_1+(x-b_2)/tau_2]. Collecting terms yields affine coefficient M=-(tau_1-tau_2)^2/(4 tau_1 tau_2), fixed point (tau_2 b_1+tau_1 b_2)/(tau_1+tau_2), and |M|<1 iff 3-2sqrt(2)<tau_2/tau_1<3+2sqrt(2). Independent exact fractions verify M_{1,6}=-25/24 and stable ratios 2:3,3:16. Equality at irrational frontier cannot occur for integral tau_i.
residual_risks: Deterministic full participation, two equal-weight clients, identical positive scalar curvature, eta=1/a and source default tau_eff.
